The primary paper names Cyclosporin A/CspA but does not print a linear or modified peptide sequence for DBAASPN_15677.
CAMP CAMPSQ24148 contains Alisporivir/Debio-025 and later SARS-CoV-2 entries not supported by this 2011 paper.

materials_exhausted.note: Local supplements were reopened by file type and antiword where applicable; supplemental tables describe interaction/GO/network support, while activity-changing values are in Figure 8 and article text.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP CspA assay rows are matched to Figure 8/text and paper metadata; CAMP CAMPSQ24148 is preserved as source_conflict because it adds later/out-of-scope values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Fifteen CspA antiviral/cell-viability rows were recovered from Figure 8, article text, and linked DBAASP rows with raw values, units, targets, and locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is bounded to CspA anti-CoV phenotype, cyclophilin/NFAT host-pathway context, and replicon evidence for replication/transcription-stage involvement.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review: No blocking rework remains after strict gate pass; final status is accepted_with_cautions rather than accepted_clean.
